comment: Month-end KYC review health (brief 5.6, PLAN 7): one row per KYC review x month-end (Apr-2023 to Sep-2026) in which the review fell due, was completed, or was overdue at the month-end (due before the month-end and not completed by it). Carries review type, the client's KYC risk rating, due / completed dates, the month's flags (due, completed, completed on time, overdue at month-end) and overdue days at the month-end, plus booking country and segment. Overdue counts are point-in-time per month-end (never sum them across months); due and completed counts are monthly flows. Storyline 7: high-risk periodic reviews overdue peak at end-May 2026 at ~3x the Apr-2025..Jan-2026 average and ~70% of that backlog was cleared by 30-Sep-2026. Grain: one row per KYC review x month-end with activity (due, completed or overdue).
